condition.narrative: Finance Agreement :Maintenance of LRNIP road sections | Description :The Borrower shall ensure, until completion of the Project,that adequate budgetary resources are allocated and made available for the maintenance of those sections of the Lifeline RoadNetwork rehabilitated under the Project. | Frequency :Yearly
